components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one solid action per area.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: calc(var(--radius) - 2px); background: var(--foreground); color: var(--background); font: 500 0.8125rem var(--font-sans); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--foreground) 90%, transparent); transition-duration: 0ms; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--ring); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary actions next to a primary.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--input); border-radius: calc(var(--radius) - 2px); background: transparent; color: var(--foreground); font: 500 0.8125rem var(--font-sans); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--state-hover); transition-duration: 0ms; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--ring); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Toolbars and row actions; no chrome until hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: none; border-radius: calc(var(--radius) - 2px); background: transparent; color: var(--muted-foreground); font: 500 0.75rem var(--font-sans); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--state-hover); color: var(--foreground); transition-duration: 0ms; } .ds-btn-ghost[aria-pressed=true] { background: var(--state-active); color: var(--foreground); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--ring); }

components.name: Input
components.description: Text field from the bb kit.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 36px; padding: 4px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--input); border-radius: calc(var(--radius) - 2px); background: transparent; color: var(--foreground); font: 400 0.8125rem var(--font-sans); transition: border-color 150ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--ring); }

components.name: Tag Chip
components.description: Retro tag on a comment; clickable to change.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 2px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 9999px; background: transparent; color: var(--muted-foreground); font: 500 11px var(--font-sans); cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip:hover { background: var(--state-hover); color: var(--foreground); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--ring); }

components.name: Attention Pill
components.css: .ds-pill-attention { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 6px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--warning) 60%, transparent); border-radius: 9999px; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--warning) 10%, transparent); color: var(--warning-text); font: 400 0.75rem var(--font-sans); }

components.name: Diagram Pin Target
components.description: Atlas overlay over a server-rendered PR Lens SVG: a click target on a node or table with no ring on hover or selection (as in PR Lens; only keyboard focus draws an outline), with a comment pin (ink when any comment is open). The SVG itself, its palette and background come from the PR Lens renderer (ADR 0001).
components.css: .ds-target { position: relative; width: 160px; height: 48px; border-radius: var(--radius); cursor: pointer; } .ds-target:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: 12px; } .ds-pin { position: absolute; top: -10px; right: -10px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 24px; height: 24px; padding: 0 4px; border: 2px solid var(--background); border-radius: 9999px 9999px 9999px 0; background: var(--foreground); color: var(--background); font: 600 11px var(--font-sans); box-shadow: var(--shadow); }

narrative.overview:
PR X-ray is a quiet, evenly lit surface where a change is laid out to be read. The chrome stays neutral and small so the code, the walkthrough and the diagrams are the subject. It is an Operate surface inside bb: dense, scannable, and native. Every color, font and radius comes from bb's active theme through CSS variables, so the plugin looks right in any bb theme, light or dark, without owning a palette of its own.

Brand lives in precise details, not decoration: a single amber "attention" voice for anything that needs the reviewer (open threads, files changed since viewed, untrusted content), monospace for anything that is a path or a commit, and instant hover feedback. Depth is flat. Borders separate things; shadows are reserved for what floats above the page.
keyCharacteristics: Theme-inherited: no hard-coded colors, fonts or radii.
Dense, small type (13px body, 11px labels) tuned for long reading sessions.
One attention color (warning) carries every "look here" signal.
Flat, border-first surfaces; shadows only for floating layers.
Quiet and exact controls: small, low-contrast, instant hover.

rules.name: The Borrowed Light Rule
rules.body: Every color is a bb theme variable. Never write a hex value in plugin UI; if a role is missing, use the nearest bb token.

rules.name: The One Attention Rule
rules.body: Anything that asks the reviewer to act uses the warning family. Don't add a second accent for attention.

rules.name: The Repo-Is-Mono Rule
rules.body: If the text is copied from the repository (path, SHA, branch), set it in mono. Nothing else is mono.

rules.name: The Light Table Rule
rules.body: Nothing on the page casts a real shadow. Only layers that float above it (chat, popovers, dialogs) do.

dos: Do use bb theme variables for every color, font, radius and shadow.
Do build from `components/ui` before writing a new control.
Do route every "needs your attention" signal through the warning family (tint fill, 50–70% border, `warning-text`).
Do set repository text (paths, SHAs) in mono.
Do keep hover instant (`duration-0` in, 150ms out) on controls.
donts: Don't hard-code hex colors or font families in plugin UI.
Don't add shadows to on-page cards beyond the hairline; save real elevation for floating layers.
Don't put more than one solid (primary) button in the same area.
Don't load remote images or media in comment or analysis content; show links or plain text.
